name: Luxury Serif
note: Quiet money: champagne-gold accent (hue 85, chroma 0.08 — gold as a whisper, not a shout), warm dark-friendly neutrals tinted at 60, Cormorant Garamond text under Playfair Display display, razor-sharp 0 radius, subtle shadows, faint grain like uncoated stock. Don't saturate the gold past 0.1 and don't round corners; luxury is restraint with expensive typography.
